Name: Auto Fairy Dust
Author: kaixindawanglpc
Description:
[b]Description[/b]
[list]
[*]Auto Fairy Dust automatically applies Fairy Dust to processing machines connected via floor path networks. No more manual clicking — just place chests with Fairy Dust nearby and let the mod handle the rest.[/*]
[*]If you've used Automate, this will feel very familiar. Configure connectors, rate limits, and visualize your network with the built-in overlay.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Installation Instructions[/b]
[list]
[*]Install SMAPI 4.1.0 or later[/*]
[*]Unzip into Stardew Valley/Mods/AutoFairyDust/[/*]
[*]Launch the game via SMAPI[/*]
[*]Configure via config.json or Generic Mod Config Menu (optional)[/*]
[/list]
[b]Main Features[/b]
[list]
[*]Automatically applies Fairy Dust to supported machines (Casks, Preserves Jars, Kegs, Crystalariums, etc.)[/*]
[*]Connect machines using floor paths — all vanilla floors supported (Wood Floor, Stone Floor, Crystal Path, etc.)[/*]
[*]Customizable rate limit — control how many Fairy Dusts are used per second[/*]
[*]Per-machine cooldown to prevent over-consumption[/*]
[*]Optional HUD message when Fairy Dust is applied[/*]
[*]Built-in overlay (configurable hotkey) to visualize connections and network groups[/*]
[*]Custom connector items — add any floor/path via config[/*]
[*]Works inside buildings (sheds, barns, coops, etc.)[/*]
[*]Generic Mod Config Menu support (optional)[/*]
[*]Also includes built-in Chinese (Simplified) translation.[/*]
[*]Other languages welcome[/*]
[/list][b]
Requirements[/b]
[list]
[*]SMAPI 4.1.0 or later[/*]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/*]
[*]Generic Mod Config Menu — optional[/*]
[/list]
[b]Shout Outs[/b]
[list]
[*]Thanks to Pathoschild for SMAPI and Automate, which inspired parts of this mod's design[/*]
[*]Thanks to the Stardew Valley modding community for their continued support[/*]
[/list]
[b]Known Issues[/b]
[list]
[*]If Automate is installed, it has its own built-in Fairy Dust automation.[/*]
[*]With both mods enabled, Fairy Dust consumption may be higher than expected.[/*]
[*]If you disable this mod but still see Fairy Dust being consumed, it's Automate's built-in feature.[/*]
[*]To disable it, set MinMinutesForFairyDust to 99999999 in Automate's config.json.[/*]
[*]A warning about this is also shown in the in-game console log and in the mod's config description.[/*]
[/list]
Source code: github.com/O-o123-code/StardewValley-AutoFairyDust
